_about: 3-23 (level22b), a new route (wave 4a, round 1): the player never takes a key. Both keys are carried by knights, and a key opens its keyhole when it is within 26 units of it, whoever carries it (ETHCallback_key #1058-1123 tests the key's own position against the keyhole's, not its owner; Keys.hpp), so the level is won by sending the blue key's knight through a portal to the blue keyhole. Won on tick 500 with four portals and no knight burned, shoved or killed: the flame at (182, 150) is not used, knight A and the yellow key are never needed, and achievement 40 (three knights alive) unlocks at the door on 500; the door's card reads medal 2 (4 portals, 8,000 ms) against the level's golden score of 2 portals.

THE WAY IN. The yellow door (x 353-383) seals the lower row between the start and both keyholes, and the other way into the middle of the level is over the upper platform (x 292-528, y 64-96, knight A patrolling its top). Left onto the lift (1-27, x 95.6) and a touch on it (tap 32, "shot": false, step 140: the lift waits on its marker until a touch sends it, one unit a tick); it tops out at y 162 on 112 and he stands at y 128.4 on it. A portal in the open air over the platform at (350, 30) (tap 114, placed 193, a 78-tick flight: from (95.6, 128.4) the ray passes the platform's corner (298.4, 64) 14 units above it; the view's top right corner holds the restart and pause buttons: a trial tap at (400, 20) restarted the level) and one on the player (tap 199, open on 201): he comes out at (350, 32) and is on the platform's top by 207, 43 units right of knight A, which is holding at its left end (x 306.7, facing left, from 208 to about 270): behind it, unseen. Right along the platform (206-292) at 2.4 units a tick and off its right end (x 528) into the gap between it and the pillar over the blue door: A turns right and sights him on 272 (he is at x 509, the exclamation) but he is over the end by 280 and its shot never leaves. He lands at (549.8, 206.4) on 300, on the lower row and right of the yellow door.

THE KEY. Knight C (minion_spawn_1959, the blue key) was walking right along wayC1 (443) to wayC0 (568, where it holds at x 561); it sights him as he falls past (293, the exclamation) and stands at (462.2, 217.4). A portal in the open air over the blue keyhole at (596, 150) (tap 304, placed 321; x 586 to 598 with y 90 to 180 all work; the keyhole is at (606, 206)) and one on knight C (tap 336 at (464.3, 217.4): the tap-time ray ends 10 units inside the knight's body and the portal opens on it, step 156): the pair opens on 359 with C inside, it comes out of the first portal at (596.2, 151.6) with its key and falls 66 units to the floor, and the key is within 26 units of the keyhole on 373 and spent (key_unlocked and the halo on 416, keyhole_1955 and door_locked_1954 gone on 466). C's one shot leaves on 334, at where he stood (549.8, 206.4), flies 38 ticks and ends there on 372: he walked on from 340 to x 614.6 beside the door (340-366), so it hits nothing, and C makes no second one. C stands where it landed until 434 and then walks left to wayC0, away from him. He waits at x 614.6 until the door goes, walks right from 440 (against the door until 466) to x 698.4 and into the door: won on tick 500.

Leans on step 140 (the lift's touch), step 156 (a shot goes to the tap-time ray's end: a portal opens in the open air, and on a knight; two taps 26 ticks apart), G10 (2.4 units a tick, no steering in the air), G1a and G1b (the two sightings, C's one shot at where he stood) and Keys.hpp (a minion carries a key; the 26 units). NOT MEASURED ON THE ORIGINAL (rig rows): that a key a knight carries opens a keyhole as the listing's bytes read it (they do not look at the owner), and that a knight standing in a portal as the pair opens goes through (R23; 3-08, 3-10 and 4-28 rest on it too). Margins (one edge moved at a time, 8 ticks either way, against this file's win_by 512): every tap and walk edge wins 4 ticks either way or more and most 8 (taps 114: -8..+7, 199: -7..+8, 304: -8..+6, 336: -6..+8; the first walk can only start later; the second walk's start -8..+4 and its end -4..+8, which win_by 512 limits (the tick is 516 at +5 and -5); a tap before the shot ahead of it has landed, or less than 26 ticks after the tap before it, is refused). With win_by loosened the knight tap alone wins from 330 to 370 (500 at 336, 554 at 370) and the keyhole portal anywhere in x 586-598, y 90-180. A walk begun 7 ticks late (347) is still at x 590 when C lands, at C's left in its sight, and it shoots him dead on 463: he must be beside the door before then.
